description: A Telecom Infrastructure Inspection Engineer (Drone-based) is responsible for inspecting and assessing telecom towers and infrastructure using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) or drones. This role combines telecom engineering knowledge with drone operation and data analysis skills to ensure telecom structures safety, functionality, and compliance.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Plan drone-based inspection of telecom infrastructure
Generate Inspection Reports and Visual Models
Implement safety and regulatory procedures in drone operations

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.COMPLETEDSPECIALIZATION: UG: Engineering/Technology (preferably in Telecom, Electronics, IT, Computer Science or UAV-related fields).

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELEVANTSPECIALIZATION: Relevant experience in Drone operations, Telecom deployment, UAV-based infrastructure inspection or other relevant domains.
eligibilityCriteriaGrid.COMPLETEDSPECIALIZATION: Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, IT, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or related fields
